title: W1 upload+collection Wiki ingestion HTTP/SDK entry over the shared WikiBuildPlanner
scope: W1 POST /api/v1/kb/wiki/ingestions (temp_file_id, collection_id, update_policy, idempotency_key): materialize the uploaded Markdown under collection.raw_sources_prefix and reuse the shared WikiBuildPlanner.prepare_sources(input_kind='upload'); returns an immutable prepared source plan, does not extract, publish or index
verified: WikiBuildPlanner.prepare_upload validates a plain .md file name, UTF-8 non-empty non-binary Markdown and the document size limit before touching storage
prepare_upload materializes at raw_sources_prefix/<name>/<name> so parser-produced relative image siblings stay addressable, then calls the same prepare_sources used by W2
an existing target with different bytes is refused unless update_policy='replace'; a byte-identical replay skips the rewrite so the same idempotency_key still returns the original build_id
prepare_sources was refactored into _persist_plan; W1 and W2 share the identical collection/schema binding, digest and plan persistence path
POST /api/v1/kb/wiki/ingestions resolves the temp upload through TempUploadStore.resolve_for_consume, reads the local copy, and always cleans it up
IngestionRequest is extra='forbid' with StrictStr fields and update_policy limited to fail|replace
async SDK kb.ingest_wiki and sync SDK wrapper call the new route
OpenAPI exposes /api/v1/kb/wiki/ingestions with a strict IngestionRequest model
not_implemented: PDF/Office upload parsing: W1 currently requires an already-Markdown upload; binary inputs must be parsed to Markdown before this stage (the parse->materialize step is not wired)
shared WikiBuildPlan execution: entity normalization, relation build, schema rule execution, publication and unified indexing (F10)
namespace/export authorization enforcement at build execution (authorize_inputs exists but is not invoked by this HTTP entry)
multi-file / directory uploads and batch task management
boundaries: The ACL context store, temp-upload store and embedding backend in the tests are fixtures; this is not a production authorization or extraction run
The returned state is 'prepared', not queued or ready; authorization_state stays 'namespace_export_pending'
The source URI is the materialized raw_sources_prefix path, not the original local upload path
No remote OpenViking/Wiki deployment or real model extraction was exercised

regression.scope: I028 suite (675) + W1 ingestion HTTP/SDK tests (7), not full repository
